story.hook: At midnight, the store rewrites itself
story.caption_explanation_en: When the date flips, packaging styles jump decades, the monitors predict seconds ahead, and a vanishing sampler keeps raiding the tray.
story.overview_ko: 자정에 상품 포장 시대가 바뀌고 모니터는 몇 초 뒤를 보여주며, 사라지는 시식의 범인이 로봇청소기였음이 드러난다.
story.continuity_ko: 장소: 24시간 편의점 내부; 시간/조명: 자정 직전에서 직후까지, 형광등 일정; 소품: 시식 트레이, 빵 부스러기, 보안 모니터 월, 선반 아래 로봇청소기; 흔적: 부스러기 자국, 바뀐 포장 디자인이 그대로 유지, 고양이의 동선과 발자국.

images.camera_strategy: Environmental wide from entrance, 24mm lens, vertical 4:5, symmetrical aisles leading lines to counter; clock at 11:59:59; mid-aisle packages mid-morph.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. A fluorescent-lit 24h convenience store moments before midnight: clean glossy floor, tidy aisles, digital wall clock reading 11:59:59. Along the middle aisle, identical products appear in two eras at once—some retro packaging already swapped where staff just faced them, others modern—caught mid-change as if a reset is about to happen. At center near the counter stands the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. Keep facial bone structure, fur placement, mouth marking, bright cheese-tabby color, four white paws, eye color, body proportions, age and size identical across all 15 images. Never abbreviate with “same cat” or “previous cat”. On the counter sits a sampling tray with bite-size snacks and a sprinkle of fresh crumbs. Realistic reflections and shadows, accurate scale/perspective, lifelike plastic/foil/paper textures, subtle air-conditioning haze, natural sensor grain, soft highlight roll-off, restrained cinematic grade. High-end documentary realism. Safety: quiet closed aisle, no people shown. Exclude: waxy fur, excessive HDR, fake bokeh, cartoon/3D look, wrong reflections, floating items, duplicate cats/limbs, human hands, logos/text.

images.camera_strategy: Intimate OTS close-up, 85mm lens, vertical 4:5, from beside the cat toward a wall of security monitors; shallow DOF; motion blur as the cat springs.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Over-the-shoulder of the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (identical appearance and features specified previously) watching a wall of security monitors. One screen displays the sampling tray three seconds in the future—its front edge beginning to slide—while the real tray in foreground still sits centered; a trail of fine crumbs on the counter points toward the snack’s usual direction of disappearance. The cat launches into a sprint, one white paw just leaving the glossy floor, muscles defined under short dense fur, whiskers swept back, ears focused; natural motion blur on the extended paw and tail tip. Packaging on nearby shelf now fully shifted to a retro look as the clock flips past midnight, matching continuity. Realistic screen glow on fur, accurate reflections on tile, lifelike metal and plastic textures. Physically plausible lighting, soft highlight roll-off, subtle sensor grain, controlled depth of field. Safety: no hazards, store closed to customers. Exclude: overprocessed color, HDR halos, fake UI overlays, text/logos, duplicate cats, human-like paws.

images.camera_strategy: Unusual viewpoint: ultra-low 16mm wide, vertical 4:5, robot vacuum POV under the shelf looking up; circular vignette edges hint device body.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. From the robot vacuum’s top camera POV under the front shelf (subtle circular housing edge visible), a 16mm ultra-wide up-angle frames the counter and the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (exact same identity and features as defined) leaning in, catching a sliding snack from the sampling tray with a gentle paw tap. In the extreme foreground, the vacuum’s soft bumper barely nudges the shelf leg, explaining the harmless tray creep; a few crumbs cling to the bumper, consistent with earlier traces. Packaging on shelves remains in the post-midnight retro style for continuity. Realistic device plastics, dust, and scuff micro-imperfections; accurate perspective and shadows; motion-appropriate blur on the tray edge; lifelike food texture. Restrained cinematic grade, soft highlight roll-off, subtle sensor grain. High-end editorial realism. Safety: slow-moving cleaning device, no risk to the cat. Exclude: plastic-looking fur, over-sharpened edges, fake bokeh, floating objects, duplicate animals/limbs, human hands, logos/text.
